parameters.query:
SELECT r.recipe_id, r.recipe_name, ui.ingredient_name as user_ingredient_name, ui.ingredient_id, u.unit_name as user_ingredient_stored_unit, uu.unit_name as user_ingredient_entered_unit, i.ingredient_name as stored_ingredient_name, cr.multiplier, {{ $json.data.quantity }} as quantity
FROM recipes r
LEFT JOIN ingredients ui on ui.ingredient_name = '{{ $json.data.ingredient_name }}'
LEFT JOIN units u on u.unit_id = ui.unit_id
LEFT JOIN units uu on LOWER(uu.unit_name) = LOWER('{{ $json.data.unit }}')
LEFT JOIN recipe_components rc on rc.recipe_id = r.recipe_id
LEFT JOIN ingredients i on rc.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id 
  AND i.ingredient_name = '{{ $json.data.ingredient_name }}'
LEFT JOIN conversion_rates cr on cr.from_unit_id = uu.unit_id
  AND cr.to_unit_id = u.unit_id
WHERE r.recipe_name = '{{ $json.data.recipe_name }}'

INSERT INTO recipe_components (recipe_id, ingredient_id, quantity_needed)
VALUES({{ $json.data.recipe_id }}, {{ $json.data.ingredient_id }},{{ $json.final_quantity }} )

SELECT 
    r.recipe_name,
    r.base_yield,
    r.unit_name, 
    COALESCE(SUM(rc.quantity_needed * i.current_cost), 0) AS total_cost
FROM recipes r
LEFT JOIN recipe_components rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id
LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON rc.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
GROUP BY r.recipe_id, r.recipe_name, r.base_yield, r.unit_name
ORDER BY r.recipe_name ASC;

SELECT 
    r.recipe_name,
    r.base_yield,
    r.unit_name as recipe_yield_unit,
    r.instructions,
    i.ingredient_name,
    rc.quantity_needed,
    u.unit_name, 
    i.current_cost,
    (rc.quantity_needed * i.current_cost) AS component_cost
FROM recipes r
LEFT JOIN recipe_components rc ON r.recipe_id = rc.recipe_id
LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON rc.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN units u on u.unit_id = i.unit_id
WHERE lower(r.recipe_name) = lower('{{ $json.data.recipe_name }}')
ORDER BY i.ingredient_name ASC;

SELECT r.recipe_id, ui.ingredient_name as user_entered_ingredient_name, ui.ingredient_id as user_entered_ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name as ingredient_component
FROM recipes r
LEFT JOIN ingredients ui on ui.ingredient_name = '{{ $json.data.ingredient_name }}'
LEFT JOIN recipe_components rc on rc.recipe_id = r.recipe_id
LEFT JOIN ingredients i on rc.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id 
  AND i.ingredient_name = '{{ $json.data.ingredient_name }}'
WHERE r.recipe_name = '{{ $json.data.recipe_name }}'
